# AutoFactory

> AutoFactory turns customer-supplied manufacturing designs into quoted, paid,
> manufactured physical goods. The initial workflow is FDM 3D printing.

New API keys require operator activation. Quotes are not orders; confirmed
payment creates an order. A human must approve the exact purchase and complete
hosted checkout. Agents do not control printers or retrieve production artifacts.
Use the operator-confirmed API origin and capabilities; do not assume production
availability, supported destinations, materials, pricing, or turnaround.

## Agent instructions

- [AutoFactory skill](https://autofactory.build/skill.md): Customer workflow, approval boundaries, and verification.
- [HTTP workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill/main/skills/autofactory/references/api-workflow.md): HTTP request examples and durable-resource readbacks.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill/main/skills/autofactory/references/troubleshooting.md): Activation, rate limits, uncertain requests, and quote conflicts.

## Optional

- [Skill repository](https://github.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill): Source, review history, and installation instructions.
